posting.title: [Job-31651] Tech Lead FullStack (.Net/React), Brazil
posting.description:
At Empresa X, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 Empresa Xers across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are looking for a Tech LeadFullstack Developer to join our team!
This role will be primarily focused on Frontend development (70%), with 30% Backend, working in a modern, collaborative environment focused on software engineering best practices.
Tech Stack
Frontend — 70%
React
Backend — 30%
.NET 8
C#
Databases
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
Entity Framework Core (EF Core)
Testing
xUnit
Bogus (Faker)
NSubstitute
Frameworks & Tools
MediatR
AutoMapper
Rebus
Git
GitFlow
Cloud, Messaging & CI/CD
Microsoft Azure
Azure DevOps
Azure Pipelines
Azure Service Bus
YAML-based CI/CD pipelines
What you’ll be working on
Developing Fullstack applications, with a stronger focus on Frontend;
Developing and maintaining APIs and services using .NET/C#;
Building user interfaces with React;
Working with relational and NoSQL databases;
Developing automated tests and applying software quality practices;
Working with messaging and event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus/Rebus;
Contributing to CI/CD processes using Azure DevOps and Azure Pipelines;
Working with Git and branching strategies such as GitFlow.
If you have experience with React + .NET/C# and are excited about this opportunity, we’d love to hear from you!
#LI-AM5
